notes: Published 2026 statutory corporate income tax; excludes local taxes and does not measure effective business tax burden. Separate state regimes must not be averaged into a metro rate. Numeric rate is the top published rate; source_display retains the complete bracket schedule. Published 8.25% reflects a 10% surtax on the 7.5% base liability for corporations with gross proceeds of at least $100 million or filing as part of a combined unitary group (source note b). The threshold is not simply taxable income.
